title: Characterize dimensions, quantities and units; establish C03 RED
commitMessage: test: establish dimensions quantities and units RED

contribution.summary: Verify three pinned authorized AURA mathematical sources, record bounded public declarations and candidate dependencies, establish independent missing-type RED for DimensionVector, Quantity and UnitDefinition, and ready C03 GREEN without speculative API claims.
contribution.value: Removes the main transfer uncertainty for a three-source dimensions/quantities slice and establishes precise source provenance and a reproducible RED, enabling the next bounded run to integrate and qualify mathematical unit and temperature semantics.
debtChanges: The C03 RED verifies that three Math types are absent, not arithmetic or affine-temperature behavior; these acceptance cases remain unqualified.
Source declaration excerpts are read-only evidence and cannot substitute for compilation and direct public API tests.
Dimension overflow and absolute/interval temperature semantics require explicit behavior qualification before C03 is complete.
contribution.nextAction: Use the recorded three-source declarations, dependencies and pinned hashes to transfer and qualify the C03 quantities, dimensions and temperature slice through independent GREEN and boundary tests.

achievements.achievement: The three owner-authorized AURA sources are individually SHA-256 verified and inspected for declarations/imports, and independently targeted tests observe that DimensionVector, Quantity and UnitDefinition are absent from Math before transfer.
